subject.title: fix(session): defer flushPendingToolResults by one event-loop tick

question: Should this external PR require redacted Feishu or comparable production-runner proof before merge, or should maintainers explicitly override the proof gate based on source and focused tests?
rationale: The code path looks plausible and narrow, but the reported failure is user-visible channel/session behavior and the PR body still lacks after-fix real behavior proof from that class of runtime.

options.title: Require production-path proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Feishu DM output, production-runner logs, or equivalent live output showing the real tool result is persisted without a synthetic missing-result entry before merge.

options.title: Override proof gate
options.body: A maintainer may intentionally accept the source-only timing risk and document why the focused helper tests are enough for this PR.

options.title: Pause behind the canonical issue
options.body: Keep this PR paused while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/84134 remains the tracker if no one can produce real transport or production-runner proof.

recommendation.title: Require production-path proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Feishu DM output, production-runner logs, or equivalent live output showing the real tool result is persisted without a synthetic missing-result entry before merge.
